title: TrueCircle V1 UAT Execution Record
description: One record per frozen UAT seeker after running match feed + card/detail review against ~50 Shared Living and ~50 Independent Places listings. Y/N fields use string enums "Y" | "N". Derived pass/fail flags are optional helpers for dashboards; authoritative formulas live in uat_execution_workbook.md.

seeker_id.description: Frozen dataset seeker id (e.g. SL-STU-01, IP-COU-03, SL-MARKET-01, IP-MARKET-01).

uat_scenario.description: Human-readable scenario label copied from the frozen seeker dataset.

marketplace.description: Expected marketplace for this seeker. Strict separation: feed must only contain listings from this marketplace.

uat_expected_result.description: Reference input from frozen seeker dataset. Used for scenario volume checks; not overwritten by execution.

uat_validation_points.description: Reference checklist from frozen seeker dataset (feed, marketplace, card, detail, empty-state checks).

expected_match_volume.description: Optional frozen-dataset hint aligning with uat_expected_result (many≈PASS, few≈LIMITED_MATCHES, none≈ZERO_MATCHES).

matches_returned.description: Count of listings returned in the seeker's marketplace feed after matching.

marketplace_correct.description: Y if every returned listing belongs to this seeker's marketplace (no cross-marketplace bleed). Y also when matches_returned is 0 and the empty state is marketplace-scoped.

top_5_listing_ids.description: Up to 5 listing ids from the top of the ranked feed (rank order preserved). Empty array when matches_returned is 0.

card_review.description: Review of the top match card (or first visible card). When matches_returned is 0, set all Y/N fields to null (N/A) and exclude from Card Pass Rate denominator.

understood_in_5_seconds.description: Y if a reviewer understands the offer within ~5 seconds.

key_facts_visible.description: Y if price, location/area, and core unit facts are visible without opening detail.

trust_visible.description: Y if trust/verification signals (or clear absence messaging) are visible on the card.

detail_page_review.description: Review of listing detail for the top match (or chosen top listing). When matches_returned is 0, Y/N fields are null (N/A); missing_information may note empty-state copy quality.

key_questions_answered.description: Y if detail answers the seeker's key questions for this marketplace (room/household vs unit/amenities, etc.).

match_explanation_helpful.description: Y if Why-this-match / explanation content is helpful and non-misleading.

missing_information.description: Free text of gaps; use empty string "" when none.

would_apply.description: Y if the reviewer would apply/contact based on card+detail. Null when matches_returned is 0 (N/A).

severity.description: Highest severity finding for this seeker run. Use critical for marketplace bleed, crash, wrong empty state, or unsafe/misleading match explanation.

finding.description: Concise observation. Use empty string "" when severity is none and nothing notable.

recommended_action.description: Follow-up action for eng/product. Use empty string "" when none.

executed_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of this execution.

executor.description: Optional reviewer or automation run id.

derived.description: Optional computed flags mirroring workbook formulas (may be filled by tooling).
